titleEn: Maximum Running Time of N Computers
title: 同时运行 N 台电脑的最长时间
summary: 电池可随时在电脑间交换，求用给定电量让 n 台电脑同时运行的最长整数分钟数。
insight: 若目标时间为 t，每块电池最多贡献 min(capacity,t)，总可用贡献至少 n*t 就可行。可行性随 t 单调，二分零到总电量除 n。
pitfalls: 单块电池超过 t 的部分不能同时供给多台电脑

solutions.title: 二分可行运行时长
solutions.idea: 用截断电量和判断某个共同运行时长。
steps: middle 取上中位；计算 available=sum(min(battery,middle))
available>=n*middle 则提高 left，否则降低 right；返回 left

code.java: class Solution { public long maxRunTime(int n,int[] batteries){long right=0;for(int battery:batteries)right+=battery;right/=n;long left=0;while(left<right){long middle=(left+right+1)/2,available=0;for(int battery:batteries)available+=Math.min((long)battery,middle);if(available>=middle*n)left=middle;else right=middle-1;}return left;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxRunTime(n:Int,batteries:IntArray):Long{var right=batteries.sumOf{it.toLong()}/n;var left=0L;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right+1)/2;var available=0L;for(battery in batteries)available+=minOf(battery.toLong(),middle);if(available>=middle*n)left=middle else right=middle-1};return left} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long maxRunTime(int n,vector<int>& batteries){long long right=accumulate(batteries.begin(),batteries.end(),0LL)/n,left=0;while(left<right){long long middle=(left+right+1)/2,available=0;for(int battery:batteries)available+=min((long long)battery,middle);if(available>=middle*n)left=middle;else right=middle-1;}return left;} };
